correctness.rationale: Root-of-unity orthogonality yields F_N=(-1)^N N P_N(z^N)/(1-z^N)^N, with P_N coefficients [t^(jN)](1+...+t^(N-1))^N. Reciprocal symmetry follows by exponent complementation. The derivative recurrence mP_(N,m+1)=((N-m)(1-w)+mNw)P_(N,m)+Nw(1-w)P'_(N,m) has alternating signs on the negative simple roots, and endpoint signs insert the left and right roots; induction gives N-1 distinct negative roots at m=N. Even N yields a unique w=-1 root by reciprocal parity; odd N has none. For fixed j, binomial/Stirling dominance yields a_(N,j)~beta_j^N/sqrt(2pi j(j+1)N) for j>=1; the j=0 exception produces the sqrt(N) prefactor. Strict logarithmic concavity of beta_j establishes separated exponential monomial rates; a uniform geometric entropy tail justifies Rouche, then Hurwitz isolates kth negative root near -a_(k-1)/a_k. This proves the fixed-k asymptotic but NOT uniformity for k growing with N. Our independent exact coefficient and negative-root isolation checks covered N=3..10 (60 checks). Minor expository slip: x log x is convex, not concave; the required concavity of its successive increments/log beta_j follows instead from decreasing second difference or a direct monotonicity proof; this does not invalidate the separation.

originality.rationale: Qualified PASS for coupled diagonal N increasing simultaneously with Cauchy-jet order and Veronese dilation, with sharp fixed-rank exponential root prefactors. final_claim: For F_N(z)=sum_{zeta^N=1}(z-zeta)^(-N), N>=3, all N(N-1) zeros are simple on N-1 negative-product regular N-gons. For fixed inner ring k, the radius tends to c_k=beta_(k-1)/beta_k with exact kth-power prefactor 2sqrt(pi N)4^-N at k=1 or sqrt((k+1)/(k-1))c_k^N at k>=2.
limitations: No fixed-rank result uniform over k growing with N; proof explicitly requires N>=2k+1.
The high-index monomial tail must be estimated uniformly; log-concavity of beta_j alone without the tail bound would not prove Rouche.
